variants.functional_evidence_statement: RT-PCR on lymphoblastoid cell lines from patients 1 and 2: band intensity in DMSO-treated (vehicle) cells from affected patients was weak compared to control cells and was stronger after cycloheximide (CHX) treatment; direct sequencing of RT-PCR products showed CHX increased the presence of the mutant allele; 'these results indicate that this nonsense variant may be subjected to NMD'.
